cluster_title: Stable-Layers: Fine-Tuning Image Layer Decomposition Models with VLM-Scored Reinforcement Learning
summary: Stability AI presented Stable-Layers, a reinforcement learning framework for image layer decomposition that uses a vision-language model as a scoring signal. The post says the approach improves layer separation, reduces blank or artifact-heavy layers, and lowers reconstruction error on the Crello dataset compared with the base model.
key_facts: Stability AI published the Stable-Layers research post on June 3, 2026.
The method fine-tunes a pretrained layer decomposition model using feedback from a vision-language model.
The post says Stable-Layers improves layer separation and reduces artifacts on the Crello dataset.
The post links to an arXiv paper.
